Hand-written Bing Webmaster API answers in the verified response shapes (`{ d: [...] }` with `__type`, WCF `/Date(ms)/` dates at UTC midnight, daily `GetRankAndTrafficStats` rows, weekly `GetQueryStats` and `GetPageStats` rows with the page URL in `Query`, `AvgClickPosition` -1 without clicks, `GetUserSites` with `Url` and `IsVerified`). Every host is a reserved example domain and every query and number is invented. Tests serve them through a fake `ctx.http`; no test opens a network connection.
